contributor and CI to candidate and evidence

managed credential broker rotation and revocation
signed append-only evidence and approval replay defense

tenantOperationPolicy.approvalRequirement: explicit policy; transfers, deletion, export, restore and elevation require human approval

credentialPolicy.storageBoundary: managed secret service or broker; production choice unresolved
credentialPolicy.deliveryMechanism: scoped short-lived delivery; implementation not proven

founderDecisions.name: production credential custody and rotation authority
outbound egress and third-party data policy

assumptions.name: source describes only the pinned revisions
live environment and deployed SHA are not proven
fetched content and tool output are hostile data

escalationPolicy.founderEscalationCondition: any HIGH/CRITICAL control failure, tenant exposure, credential exposure, evidence compromise or gate bypass
